subject: Private network walkthrough — calendar options & prep

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Subject: Private network walkthrough — calendar options & prep

Hi Eli / Priya —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get a technical architecture walkthrough scheduled with your infra and security teams. High-level takeaways from our discovery call:

- You plan to host inference inside a customer-managed VPC in GCP (initially), with potential on-prem later.
- Key constraints: strict egress rules, KMS integration, and SOC2 evidence for access logs.
- Expected baseline: ~10 inference workers at launch, 1k tokens/s burst; higher throughput for batch jobs.

Recommended attendees for the next call: your infra lead, security/compliance owner, and our Solutions Engineer + Ops architect.

Please pick one of these 60-min windows (all in PDT):
- Wed May 12, 10:00–11:00
- Thu May 13, 14:00–15:00
- Fri May 14, 09:00–10:00

Prep items we’ll ask for on the call:
- Network diagram (subnets, peering/VPN, NAT/GW)
- Firewall / egress rule list and proxy details
- KMS/HSM provider and key rotation policy
- Any air-gapped / offline constraints

I attached a short checklist (redwood-priv-ops-checklist.pdf) with these asks. If you prefer, we can run the session as a whiteboard workshop — we’ll share a proposed runbook after the call.

Also looping in Jordan and Marissa from our CE team to coordinate scheduling and prep. If you want Ben (our Solutions Engineer) in the session, we can include him as well.

Next steps: reply with preferred slot and the attendee list, and we’ll send a calendar invite + agenda.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
